content: {"episode_id":"ep-05005","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that the required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation. Given the intermittent symptoms, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate clinical events with electrocardiographic findings. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
